name: ystack-stats
description: /ystack-stats shows what ystack saves you, from your own logs: your last days of API calls re-priced under ystack's rules, and real usage per active hour before and after you installed it. '/ystack-stats share' prints a paste-ready summary with numbers only.

days.title: Days to count
days.description: How many days of logs the what-if replay re-prices (1-90). The before/after view uses up to this many days on each side of the install.
